clips.title: The story
paras: At Lushwater Oasis, Hezrul Bloodmark directs the Kolkar incursions across the Barrens. Regthar Deathgate sends you to end his command and break the centaur's hold on the region.

After Barak Kodobane and Verog the Dervish fall, Hezrul Bloodmark remains the Barrens Kolkar's paramount chieftain. Regthar Deathgate calls him brutal and cunning, the spearhead behind the centaur incursions across the savanna. The Horde hopes his death will sow chaos and fracture the Kolkar ranks beyond recovery, before they can overwhelm Horde settlements.

Hezrul commands his warbands from Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads. The few watering holes in the Barrens are vital to survival, making this oasis a strategic hub and a staging ground for Kolkar raiders. On Hezrul's own ground, you deny the centaur their most vital stronghold and sever their hold on the southern trails.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens. He is fierce, brutal and cunning. Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.
So kill him. As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.
He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I commend you, friend. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. In defeating them, your valor is proven.
